answer: Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The fable graph is validated at intake and the jetty frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and orchard anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Scaling up is where the attack dies: 1599 fake identities need 1109 separate proofs, each held 14 days, so the bill grows in a straight line while the reward stays flat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
